notes: All 7 snapshot files across 6 pages were readable Common Crawl captures (no live copies in this chunk). Weatherhead (CWRU) alumni rosters run title, employer and city together without separators; the extractor split them by judgment and kept the location in note. The Doctor of Management alumni page mixes degrees (PhD and DM) and is a professional/executive doctorate, not an operations PhD program; the Designing Sustainable Systems pages are the PhD in Management track for DM graduates. Affiliations on those rosters are current at capture date, not first placements. The 2019 snapshot of the DSS Class of 2015 page lists three names absent from the 2017 snapshot (Madden, Summers, Walker) and drops all affiliations. The CORC and Columbia Business School pages are dissertation lists; their years are dissertation years of unstated meaning. The Aalborg page is a single thesis record with no year; the HCCI program is not an operations program.
